nodes.description: Second call to gnutls_x509_crl_deinit reads 8 bytes from the freed CRL object. The crl argument is the same dangling pointer freed at pkcs12.c:1745.

edges.description: The stale *crl pointer value from the error-path deinit at line 1745 propagates unchanged to the cleanup deinit at line 1791. Because *crl was not set to NULL, the cleanup guard passes and calls gnutls_x509_crl_deinit with the freed pointer.

root_cause_criterion.description: After gnutls_x509_crl_deinit(*crl) in the error path at line 1745, *crl must be set to NULL. The fix adds '*crl = NULL;' after this deinit. Without this assignment, *crl retains the freed pointer, causing the done: cleanup to call gnutls_x509_crl_deinit a second time.
